texts.preamble: Karun vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 9 September, 2019 Author: Shailendra Shukla Bench: Shailendra Shukla
texts.facts: The length of the argument is that the case under Section 16(1) of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 was tried by Judicial Magistrate First Class, where as he was not empowered. He has pointed out the notification No.3369-XVII-Med.-IV dated 11.10.1977 which is reproduced as under:- "In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 16A of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 (No.27 of 1954), the State Government hereby empowers:- (1) Chief Judicial Magistrates at headquarters of all revenue districts in the State; (2) Additional Chief Judicial Magistrates at headquarters of all revenue districts in the State; and (3) Senior most presiding officers of Courts of Judicial Magistrates of First Class at Headquarters of all Tahsils in the State; not being also headquarters of revenue districts; to try all offences under sub-section(1) of Section 16 of the said Act in summary way.
texts.arguments: (2) The First Class Magistrate, who is senior in Service, may be treated as the senior most Magistrate, First Class in a Tahsil Headquarter." Learned counsel submits that the case was tried by Judicial Magistrate First Class headquarter at Dhar and as per notification was not empowered to try the offence under Section 16(1) of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 . He has placed reliance on the judgment in the cases of Karun vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 9 September, 2019 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/170216655/ 1 Premnarayan Rathi Vs. State of M.P.1195 (II) MPWN 112, Chintulal Vs. Asharam 1992 (II) MPWN 116, Muneem Vs. State of M.P., 1994 (II) MPWN 103, Sonelal Vs. State of M.P. 1972 JLJ 1031 in which it has been held that the Judicial Magistrate First Class was not empowered to try offences under Section 16(1) of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 as per the notification. These apart Section 461 of Cr.P.C. is also relevant in which it has been stated that if any Magistrate, not being empowered by law in this behalf, does any of the following things namely .................. or (l) tries an offender.........his proceedings shall be void.
